title: Everyday Habits to Extend Your Haircut in Norwich
description: Practical tips to keep your haircut looking sharp between barber visits — washing, styling, small fixes and when to pop into 3D Cutz on Prince of Wales Road.

content.heading: Wash and condition the right way
paragraphs: Washing too often can strip natural oils and leave hair looking flat; many styles do well with every other day or even less, using dry shampoo to freshen between washes. When you do shampoo, pick a gentle formula and apply conditioner only to mid-lengths and ends to avoid weighing the roots down.
Pat your hair dry with a towel rather than rubbing vigorously, and if you use a hairdryer choose a lower heat setting. Controlled drying helps maintain the shape without causing damage.

content.heading: Choose and use products sparingly
paragraphs: Less is usually more. Warm a small amount of paste, wax or pomade between your palms before working it through your hair so it distributes evenly. Apply to damp hair for a natural hold or to dry hair for more texture.

For short fades and neat lines avoid heavy, greasy products that can blur the cut. Dry shampoo and a light matte paste or sea-salt spray are useful for adding volume and grip without flattening your style.

content.heading: Style and sleep smart
paragraphs: Comb or brush your hair into shape while damp and use a short burst of cool air from the dryer to set it. Regularly styling in the intended direction helps hair sit that way as it grows out, keeping the silhouette tidier.
Consider a satin or silk pillowcase to reduce friction overnight — it helps prevent flattening and frizz, so the cut keeps its shape for longer.

content.heading: Manage small fixes and know when to visit 3D Cutz
paragraphs: You can do tiny maintenance jobs at home — trimming a few long ends with scissors or using a trimmer with a long guard for stray hairs — but avoid reshaping a fade yourself. Small, cautious tweaks are fine; major changes are best left to a pro.

If the outline of your cut has softened or a fade is losing its contrast, it’s time for a tidy-up. Pop into 3D Cutz at 19 Prince of Wales Road, Norwich NR1 1BD for a professional touch-up to keep the look sharp between full haircuts.
